planApproval.note: While 'required', /plan-issue stops after posting a plan; the user approves before /execute. Propose 'auto' via a retro PR once plan feedback has been quiet for several runs — the user decides.

merge.docsOnlyRule: A PR is docs-only iff EVERY changed file ends in .md. Anything else — code, JSON/YAML config, hooks, CI, infra — is a code PR.
merge.codeRule: Code PRs: CI green, then label 'awaiting-review', notify the user, do NOT merge; continue with independent tickets while it waits.
merge.note: Propose flipping code→auto via a retro PR once review-feedback categories have gone quiet — the user decides.
